items.title: Ulta Beauty (ULTA) Adds Exclusive Brand Launch And 250 Store Rollout
items.summary: Ulta Beauty (NasdaqGS:ULTA) is partnering with hair wellness brand Nutrire for an exclusive retail launch on Ulta.com, followed by a rollout to 250 stores across the US. Nutrire joins Ulta Beauty's Sparked program, which focuses on growth brands curated for early stage discovery.
